## Problem

What larger workflow or integration is blocked by the current behavior?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-facing CLI, Python API, config, or storage behavior you want.

## Alternatives considered

List any workaround, local patch, or different architecture you considered.

## Compatibility impact

Note whether this changes public imports, CLI output, JSON shape, SQLite schema,
provider behavior, or documented workflows.
